name: external_editor_open
description: ED-1: a person chooses Studio's Custom external editor, introduces a shader compile error, and clicks its Problems row. The real helper process receives the source file and its diagnostic line and column; repairing the shader clears the problem.

log_allow.reason: The scenario deliberately writes vaule0 into present.frag, opens the row, then repairs the shader.
